input:
We’re really pushing for automatic claim progress messages to go out via SMS and email to policyholders at each milestone — it’s a big gap for us right now.
The platform lacks automatic claim progress notifications via SMS and email.

Yes, please — and include reporting and letters too. We need full visibility across all touchpoints.
The product does not currently provide reporting, letters, and full visibility across all touchpoints.

We’re seeing a pattern where our motor teams are asking for more automation in claim routing — especially by postcode and workload — but our commercial side insists on keeping it manual for complex cases... we really need configuration that varies by team to keep everyone happy.
The claim routing feature lacks configurable automation that can vary by team and case complexity.

It’s the MI dashboard versus the CSV export. The numbers don’t line up, and finance is questioning which one to trust.
The numbers shown in the MI dashboard do not match those in the CSV export, causing confusion about which data source is accurate.

We’re under pressure to improve policyholder communication, and claim progress messages are key for us right now.
The customer needs better claim progress messaging to improve policyholder communication.

Every time we upload a garage estimate, it lands in correspondence — it’s a wrong document category and handlers keep missing key evidence because of it, which delays claims resolution.
Garage estimates are being categorized as correspondence, causing handlers to miss key evidence and delay claim resolution.

we’re seeing a mismatch between what’s shown on the MI dashboard and the figures we get when exporting CSVs — it’s causing some confusion in finance.
The MI dashboard numbers do not match the figures in the exported CSV files, causing confusion.

I’m still waiting on those automatic claim progress messages for policyholders — we were told Q1 next year, but it’s dragging and handlers are fielding repeat calls.
The automatic claim progress messages for policyholders have not been delivered as promised, causing delays and repeat calls.

dashboard totals don’t match what they export, and they’re worried the numbers aren’t reliable for reporting.
Dashboard totals do not match the exported data, making the numbers unreliable for reporting.

Your last update moved some controls without warning. Our teams had to retrain because of unexpected interface changes — and we’re still seeing errors from it.
Unexpected interface changes moved controls, requiring retraining and causing errors.

Can you walk me through how to assign roles to new claims handlers in the dashboard?
User doesn't know how to assign roles to new claims handlers in the dashboard.

Reports: click "Overview", dead x1
The user cannot access the Reports Overview page.

When a reserve exceeds authority and the approver’s out with no delegate, it just piles up — that approval waiting list causes unnecessary delays and frustrates our team.
Approvals get stuck when the designated approver is unavailable and no delegate is set, causing claim delays.

we’re still manually calling garages because the system doesn’t show live repair updates, which eats up half our morning
The system does not provide live repair updates, forcing the team to call garages manually.

when we upload garage estimates, they’re landing in the wrong document category—like under Correspondence—and we’re having to manually move them, which risks things slipping through the cracks... they’re being auto-sorted into the wrong document category, which forces us to manually reassign them — and sometimes that leads to important evidence being missed during review.
Uploaded garage estimates are automatically categorized incorrectly, requiring manual re‑assignment.

It’s a small thing but causes delays in handling claims properly.
A minor issue is causing delays in processing claims.

any update on the reserve calculation logic? We need it aligned with our reporting standards.
The reserve calculation logic does not match the customer's reporting standards.

We’re also struggling with supplier comms and task tracking — it’s all tied together.
The user finds it hard to manage supplier communications and task tracking within the platform.

We handle hundreds daily and need bulk uploads.
The platform lacks an efficient bulk upload feature for large numbers of files.

we’d really appreciate fewer surprises and more notice before any major shifts in how we access claims or documents.
Customers experience unexpected changes to how they access claims or documents, leading to surprise and frustration.

I need to reset my password for the Keelwater portal — I’ve forgotten it and can’t log in to review claims or update reserves.
The user cannot log in because they have forgotten their password and need to reset it.

Reports: click "Export CSV", error exception
Exporting a CSV from the Reports page throws an error.

Tasks: click "Details" ... click "Save", rage x3
The task requires clicking Details then Save, which is frustrating and inefficient.

we’re still waiting on the document upload permissions for our policyholders’ claims portal
Document upload permissions have not been enabled, blocking policyholders from uploading files.

we’re having trouble pulling the latest reserves report for our policyholders... It’s showing outdated figures even after we re-synced the integrations.
The reserves report displays outdated figures even after re‑syncing the integrations.

our finance team’s noticed the report totals differ — they’re comparing dashboard numbers with exported files and getting confused.
Report totals shown on the dashboard do not match the numbers in exported files.

just wanted to flag a few things we’ve run into since going live — nothing critical, but they’re slowing us down a bit.
The onboarding process has minor issues that are slowing the team down.

can we turn off auto-routing for our commercial claims? They’re too complex.
The customer cannot disable auto-routing for commercial claims, which are too complex.

I’m trying to update our team’s access levels and I’m stuck on assigning roles for new staff.
The user cannot assign roles to new staff in the access level settings.

click "Link to existing claim", dead x1
The "Link to existing claim" button does not work.

I’m having trouble logging into the system — I think I need to reset my password.
The user cannot log in and needs to reset their password.

I’m having trouble locating the updated reserves after finalising a claim
The customer cannot find the updated reserves after finalizing a claim.

we’ve had several instances where the same loss gets reported twice — once by phone, once via web — and the system doesn’t warn us... it creates duplicate claims and messes up our reserves and reporting.
The system fails to warn about duplicate claim submissions, leading to duplicate records and inaccurate reserves.

Can you walk me through how to attach supporting documents to a claims file in the system?
The user does not know how to attach supporting documents to a claims file.

No delegate at all — and it’s causing delays on reserve updates that need sign-off before we can process payments.
The user has no delegate assigned, causing delays in reserve updates that need sign‑off before payments can be processed.

click "Document type", rage x5
The document type selection requires excessive clicking.

Exactly. That’s the problem — no warning, no link option, just two claims.
The platform shows no warning or link option and only displays two claims.

I’ve been stuck on this since this morning and it’s holding up the reporting cycle.
The user cannot make progress in the system, delaying the reporting cycle.

the numbers aren’t lining up. Could you help me trace where the mismatch might be?
The reserves update data does not match the payments data, causing a reconciliation mismatch.

Also, your interface changes lately — controls moving without warning — it’s forcing us to retrain staff constantly.
The interface is changing unpredictably, forcing staff to be retrained.

when a reserve change goes beyond what a handler can approve, it just sits there.
Reserve changes that exceed a handler's approval limit get stuck and are not processed.

we’re getting locked out of Keelwater every time we try to log in — it keeps saying the system is down, but I’m pretty sure it’s not actually your side.
Users are locked out when trying to log in, receiving a system‑down message that appears inaccurate.

It’s a real drag — every time we need to update a policyholder or adjust reserves, we have to interrupt our workflow to phone suppliers because repair updates missing means no visibility.
Repair updates are missing in the platform, so users lack visibility and must call suppliers.

We’re drowning in repair updates missing again this week — it’s eating into our daily tasks... we’re stuck calling garages every day because repair updates missing — it’s a constant drag on our team’s productivity and delays claim resolution.
Repair updates are missing from the platform, forcing the team to call garages manually and delaying claim resolution.

Hi Bryn, I’m trying to reconcile the reserves for our latest batch of claims but the system isn’t pulling through the supplier payments correctly — any idea what might be causing that?
The system fails to pull supplier payments correctly when reconciling reserves.

Documents: click "Open" ... click "Save", rage x3
Users get frustrated because opening and saving documents doesn't work properly.

I need to reset my password because I can’t access the claims dashboard to upload documents.
The user cannot access the claims dashboard because they need to reset their password.

Could you walk me through how to upload supporting documents for a claim? I keep getting stuck at the supplier validation step.
The user cannot upload supporting documents because they get stuck at the supplier validation step.

We'll tweak the monitor settings for now and wait for updates on dark mode.
The product lacks a dark mode feature that the user needs.

Our motor team wants more automatic claim allocation based on postcode and workload, but commercial prefers manual control for complex cases — we need per-team configuration.
The platform lacks per‑team configuration for automatic claim allocation versus manual control.

It’s a real drag — every time we need to update a policyholder or adjust reserves, we have to interrupt our workflow to phone suppliers because repair updates missing means no visibility.
Missing repair updates force users to interrupt their workflow and call suppliers for visibility.

I’m trying to upload some policyholder documents for a recent claim but the interface isn’t showing the upload field — is there a permissions issue or a step I’m missing?
The upload field does not appear when trying to add policyholder documents, possibly due to permissions or a missing step.

I can’t access the documents section — it’s saying my credentials are expired.
The user cannot access the documents section because their credentials have expired.

We’re constantly phoning suppliers because there’s no live repair status, which is a daily blocker for us — garage progress visibility is critical to our workflow.
The platform does not provide live repair status, forcing manual phone follow‑ups.

Finance keeps questioning the numbers because the dashboard totals don’t match the export figures mismatch — I’ve re-exported three times and it’s consistent with UTC cutoff, not UK time.
Dashboard totals do not match exported figures, causing finance to question the numbers.

Documents: click "Document type", rage x5
The document type selector is difficult to use, requiring multiple clicks.

That’ll be useful — we need better oversight on reserves and supplier performance.
The customer lacks sufficient oversight on reserves and supplier performance.

We’re running claims reports late into the evening and the bright interface is straining our eyes — any chance we can get dark mode enabled?
The bright interface strains users' eyes when running claims reports late at night.

We often need to upload files together when opening a new claim, especially when policyholders send in bundles. Right now, it’s one by one, which slows us down.
Users cannot upload multiple files at once when creating a new claim, causing delays.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal — I’ve forgotten it and can’t log in to check my reserves or documents.
The user cannot log in because they forgot their password.

your platform’s recent interface tweaks are throwing off our team’s rhythm
The recent interface tweaks are disrupting the team's workflow.

We just need some stability so we can focus on policyholders, not relearning the software.
The software is unstable, forcing users to constantly relearn it.

Our motor team wants claims routed automatically based on postcode and workload, but our specialty handlers need manual control for complex cases — it’s a team-level thing. We need manual claim routing options configurable per team.
The platform lacks configurable manual claim routing options for different teams.

Also, I need to update the supplier details for a couple of claims — can you help me find where that’s managed?
User cannot locate where to update supplier details for claims.
